decisions.reason: As a recent extension of the established radiant-heater line, this burner component fits the service-and-upgrade business, but its lower website prominence suggests a somewhat higher risk of being folded into the standard portfolio.
The electric infrared panel heater was given its own product page and matches the firm's move toward lower-carbon, energy-efficient heating solutions for non-residential spaces.
The electric halogen infrared heater also supports electrified heating demand, though it may face a bit more portfolio overlap and niche-use risk than the panel format.
An industrial electric infrared hall heater is very close to the firm's core customer needs and strategic direction, so an expanding firm would usually continue backing it.

The hydrogen-capable gas dark infrared heater is strongly aligned with the firm's stated future focus and was highlighted with a concrete real-world launch, making withdrawal unlikely in the near term.
